Republicans face electoral challenges amid Trump's declining popularity

As the US midterm election campaign enters its final phase, several Republican candidates are reportedly concerned that former President Donald Trump's declining popularity and rhetoric could negatively impact their chances. Polls suggest Trump's low approval ratings may pose a liability for the party as it seeks to maintain its congressional majorities. Some candidates worry that Trump's influence could cost them votes in the upcoming November elections.
